interface.longDescription: AI Expert for 3DCP helps researchers, engineers, students, and industry professionals understand 3D concrete printing materials and processes. It supports mixture-design discussions, interpretation of experimental results, research planning, hypothesis development, and education using curated scientific references and experimental databases. Recommendations and statistical relationships require validation for the materials, equipment, and testing conditions of each project.
